svg.text: - Basic: filter DB → slow (wildcard LIKE = full table scan)

svg.text: - Fix: Elasticsearch (inverted index), synced from Postgres via CDC

svg.text: - OCC / row lock = never double book

svg.text: - Reserve: Redis lock SET NX EX, TTL 10 min
